evidence_tree.built_with: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <fresh scratch dir>
evidence_tree.isolation: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md from the export were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/ and git history were not read.

independent_computation.step_1_resource_type: data/champions.json -> Syndra.resource = "MANA"; every active ability entry (Q/W/E/R) carries "resource": "MANA". Syndra has no secondary casting resource for Q/W/E/R.
independent_computation.step_3_which_casts_can_cost_60: 60 is a wiki-listed Syndra mana cost in exactly two places: Dark Sphere at rank 5 (40/45/50/55/60 -> 60) and Force of Will at rank 1 (60/70/80/90/100 -> 60). Both are legal, sourced cast costs. The scenario is pinned at 120 Splinters of Wrath, which per the passive text requires late-game accumulation ('stacking up to 120 times'; rank-ups alone cap at 85 Splinters), so the maxed-rank reading (Dark Sphere rank 5 = 60) is the one consistent with the scenario name; the rank-1 reading (Force of Will = 60) lands on the same number.
independent_computation.step_4_which_casts_can_cost_0: No Syndra ability activation is free. The only zero-cost action in the sourced kit is the Force of Will *recast* ('Force of Will can be recast while the target is being held'), which is the second half of one already-paid activation, not a separately-costed ability. A Dark Sphere cast fired from a stocked charge is NOT free either: the charge is ammo, a distinct engine resource. data/wiki-atoms/stack-transform-summon-resource.json documents ammo as 'A resource (internal index 12) ... stocked ability casts (Ahri's Spirit Rush, Gangplank's Powder Keg, Syndra's Dark Sphere)', and the internal-resource-index atom lists '0 mana ... 12 ammo' as separate types. Consuming a stocked Dark Sphere charge therefore spends ammo *in addition to* Dark Sphere's mana cost; the wiki text grants no mana exemption for the Transcendent charge.
independent_computation.step_5_relevance_of_the_120_option: data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json records for Syndra: 'E3 implemented the Transcendent splinter system (splinters option: 120 -> 1.15x AP buff, 40+ Q charges via Q2 slot, 60+ W true damage)'. At 120 Splinters every threshold is live, including the 40-Splinter Dark Sphere charge that produces the extra Dark Sphere cast entry in the timeline. That extra cast is a full Dark Sphere activation and must bill Dark Sphere's mana cost.
independent_computation.step_6_sanity_check_affordability: Stat growth (docs/math-foundations.md, Section 5: base + growth*(L-1)*(0.7025 + 0.0175*(L-1))) on Syndra's sourced mana (flat 480, perLevel 40) gives at L=18: 480 + 40*17*(0.7025 + 0.0175*17) = 480 + 680*1.0 = 1160 mana. A 60-mana cast is affordable, so a 0.0 reading cannot be explained by an out-of-mana clamp.
independent_computation.conclusion: The correct resource_cost for a Syndra ability cast at this leaf is 60.0 mana (Dark Sphere at rank 5 under the maxed-rank reading; Force of Will at rank 1 under the rank-1 reading - both sourced to the same 60). 0.0 is not a sourceable cost for any Syndra ability activation.

alternative_hypothesis_considered.hypothesis: cast_timeline[1] is the Force of Will *recast* (the throw), which is genuinely free, making 0.0 the correct value and 60.0 a double-charge.
alternative_hypothesis_considered.why_rejected: It requires the timeline to split one W activation into two entries with the grab at index 0, for which the exported data carries no evidence, and it is inconsistent with the scenario's own documented shape: at 120 Splinters the Dark Sphere charge (40+ threshold, recorded in data/champion-audit/batch-e9-1.json as the 'Q2 slot') adds a genuine second Dark Sphere activation early in the timeline, and that activation's sourced mana cost at rank 5 is exactly 60. Under every self-consistent reading of the sourced data that puts a *costed* Syndra activation at index 1, the value is 60; the 0.0 reading requires an uncosted recast entry that the wiki cost fields do not enumerate.
alternative_hypothesis_considered.residual_uncertainty: The oracle did not read the scenario definition (scripts/, tests/ are out of scope by runbook), so the ability identity at index 1 is inferred from the sourced cost ladder rather than observed. The ruling rests on the fact that 60.0 is a wiki-listed Syndra cast cost while 0.0 is not a wiki-listed cost for any Syndra ability.
